headword: {耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}

definitions.explanation: A building design that uses strong, rigid structural elements to withstand earthquake forces without collapsing. One of three main approaches to earthquake engineering in Japan, alongside seismic isolation and vibration damping.

examples.japanese: このビルは{耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}だ。
examples.english: This building has an earthquake-resistant structure.

examples.japanese: {耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}の{基準|きじゅん}を{満|み}たしているか{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I confirmed whether it meets earthquake-resistant structural standards.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{建物|たてもの}を{耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}に{改修|かいしゅう}する{工事|こうじ}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Renovation work to make old buildings earthquake-resistant is underway.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{大|おお}きな{地震|じしん}の{経験|けいけん}を{踏|ふ}まえて、{耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{発展|はってん}してきた。
examples.english: In Japan, earthquake-resistant structural technology has developed based on the experience of major earthquakes.

notes:
Composed of {耐震|たいしん} (earthquake-resistant) and {構造|こうぞう} (structure, construction). Japan's strict building codes require most structures to incorporate seismic resistance, making this term common in news, real estate, and daily conversation.

Japanese earthquake engineering distinguishes three main approaches:
- {耐震|たいしん} (earthquake-resistant): the building is strong enough to endure shaking
- {免震|めんしん} (seismic isolation): the building is isolated from ground motion using special bearings
- {制震|せいしん} (vibration damping): the building absorbs and dissipates seismic energy

After the 1981 revision of Japan's Building Standards Act, buildings meeting the new code are called {新耐震|しんたいしん} (new seismic standard), a key term in real estate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}の{建物|たてもの}: earthquake-resistant building
- {耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}に{改修|かいしゅう}する: to retrofit for earthquake resistance
- {耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}の{基準|きじゅん}: seismic structural standards
- {耐震構造|たいしんこうぞう}の{設計|せっけい}: earthquake-resistant structural design

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {免震構造|めんしんこうぞう}: seismic isolation structure — uses isolators to decouple the building from ground shaking
- {制震構造|せいしんこうぞう}: vibration-damping structure — uses dampers to absorb earthquake energy
- {耐震|たいしん}{補強|ほきょう}: seismic reinforcement — strengthening an existing building rather than building anew
